in_sanskrit.name: Nivetha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है New Birth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nivetha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Nivetha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nivethana', which means 'New Birth' or 'Fresh Beginning'. It is believed that this name was given to babies born during the Navratri festival, symbolizing the renewal of life and the blessings of the nine Goddesses.
